notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Fixed pachinko machine issues.
Morning, day, evening, and night now have equal duration.
Fish can now be sold not only to Rufus but also in the shop (it does not appear in the assortment and does not affect rating if absent).
Wood can now be sold to Rufus.
Fixed tooltip sizes when hovering over avatars or quests.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes: Work buildings now become transparent if they block the view.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Added protection against using the Martingale strategy in slot machines.[/p][/*][*][p]Added 3 more cashier work speed levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Items dropping from buildings now appear in a more accessible location.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed medicine prices.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with crafting roll-ups.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the old Rufus shop showing when switching between ([b]Buy raw materials[/b] / [b]Sell raw materials[/b]) buttons.[/p][/*][*][p]Items on the large shelf no longer stick out past the bar.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed customer dialogue lines showing <NULL>.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update
notes.notes: [list][*][p]Shop visitors now get stuck less often.[/p][/*][*][p]Served visitors leave without getting caught on objects.[/p][/*][*][p]The storekeeper no longer collides with buildings.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug in Nala’s quest with the pre-purchased Dead Man’s Hat: the quest now continues if you open the hat shop.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a black screen issue when opening the PC and exiting to the monument.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update
notes.notes: Fixed customers getting stuck after moving the shelf they were heading to

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Fixed issues with button display in the hat shop and localization errors in hat names.
Fixed localization errors.
Fixed several quests.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes: Fixed several quests and text errors

notes.title: Cashier and Storekeeper Payment Update
notes.notes:
The cashier now receives a salary only when actually selling an item, instead of every second.
The storekeeper now receives a salary only when placing items on the shelves, instead of every second.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Fixed the functionality of some quests.
Fixed a bug with chromatic aberration during loading.
Fixed the caret behavior in Rufus’s shop text field.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Fixed duplication of processes in the “current tasks” tab.
Fixed a bug with Axel’s perfect shooting quest.
Fixed an issue where store item colors were reset after the second load.
Fixed a bug where a building was moved instead of constructing a new one.
Increased the prices of energy drinks.
Fixed several spelling and logical errors in the text.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Added the ability to enter the quantity of purchased items using the keyboard.
Implemented item transfer with Shift + click.
Added item sorting with the middle mouse button.
Fixed a bug where dialogues could freeze when pressing E twice quickly near a character.
Minor bugs fixed (and, as always, some new ones added).

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Adjusted the balance of wine and chacha prices.
Fixed a bug where purchased raw materials were sold without demand modifiers.
Added an option to change the maximum FPS.
Added explanations on how to expand the assortment in Rufus’s shop.
Fixed the character freezing near NPCs when trying to start a dialogue.

notes.title: Bugfixes
notes.notes: [p]This update fixes the following issues:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed character overexposure when playing with OpenGL.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the coefficient bar when selling items.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed multiple issues related to gifts.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Magnus’s dialogue getting stuck.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the problem where customers couldn’t walk on carpets.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the missing save when no name was entered.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with the cash register timer.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several spelling and logical errors in the text.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for playing and reporting problems![/p]
